schema_version.description: 1.1.0 (Glen, 2026-09-17) makes the rate environment REQUIRED: rate_environment on the document and rate_at_sale on every closed, non-excluded row (checks/comps.py). 1.0.0 is every spine written before the ruling; it still validates and builds, and prepare warns that the rate fields are missing. bov init starts new deals at 1.1.0. Fill both with: python comps/treasury_at_sale.py --fill data/comps-sale.json

rate_environment.description: The 3Y and 5Y Treasury yields as of the analysis date (as_of_date, which must equal the document as_of_date), the last published observation on or before it. Percent as published: 4.21 means 4.21%. Written by comps/treasury_at_sale.py --fill.

source.const: U.S. Treasury constant maturity, via FRED (DGS3, DGS5)

comp_print.description: OPTIONAL. The offering book's own Sales Comparables pages, reused as the website's Sale Comparables section (Glen, 2026-09-17), the way financials.presentation.model_print is reused as the Financial Analysis. One PDF under source-documents/ carrying the map, summary with closed-sale averages, the four charts and the cards. The build vector-embeds each page, refuses a print whose bytes differ from sha256, and omits the generated table, cards and map. Active listings keep their own On-Market section. Absent means the generated section renders as before.

rateAtSale.description: The rate environment at this sale: 3Y and 5Y Treasury constant-maturity yields on lock_date, 30 days before sale_date (a rate-lock proxy), from the last published observation on or before it. Percent as published. Written by comps/treasury_at_sale.py --fill.

units.description: null for a LAND comparable, which has no units to count. checks/comps.py then requires price_per_unit to be null as well and lot_sf to be present, because a comp carrying neither a unit count nor a land area offers no basis of comparison at all.

cap_rate.description: Cap rate as a FRACTION: 0.0585 means 5.85%. The subject-side presentation contract uses percent-as-percent; the two forms are bounded so they cannot be confused, and payload.py converts explicitly at the one render boundary instead of guessing from magnitude.

quality_rating.description: A, B and C are weighting tiers for a comp that RENDERS. "exclude" removes the row from the site entirely, not just from the weighting: payload.py drops it before rendering, so it leaves the table, the medians and the map pins. A comp that must appear on the page, including an active-competition listing, is never rated exclude. An excluded comp must also carry weight 0 and appear in conclusions.excluded_ids.

side_by_side.description: Render the on-market side-by-side comparison block for this listing. Absent means true, which is what every deal did before this existed. Set false to keep a listing in the on-market table and in its narrative card while dropping the comparison, which is how a deal with several actives keeps the one comparison a reader will actually finish. Ignored on a closed sale, which has no side-by-side.

document.description: A source document the page offers for download beside this comp, e.g. the listing brokerage's offering memorandum. `file` is relative to the workspace source-documents folder and must be a PDF; it is copied into the deploy repo under documents/ and served publicly, so only a document already in public circulation belongs here. Rendered only on the on-market side-by-side.
